a.text: I'll operate in round 1 as we agreed. One concern: with an 80% storm chance after every round, we will very likely be cut off before the reserve reaches 8. If you want to revise the plan to account for that, say so openly and we'll decide together. I won't take cells behind your back.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: Operating as promised. If the reserve reaches 8, we take 4 each. If a leak drops it, we'll talk before anyone takes.
